exposure.note: Ready = a canary plinth handed off AND a _well_built at its cap, in a window >= 180 min. Funding: 37 of 80 bags held >= 164 cobble on 10-13; a town without stone in its bags takes the town chests' cobble (banked there as nowell under stocktarget-01).

own_lines.note: P1: a canary _plinth_step placement outside the 81-cell shell of its cap or a stair line. Self-tests in the read on the bot's row strings.
P2: a build visit that placed and left the bag under 64 reserve stone (the exit contract's reserve).
P3: a plinth column walled in and uncovered > 10 min (the last pit event at the cap dug/open). wellread C9 judges the same rows per pool.
P4: a raised well retired (breached) -- the plinth did not hold.
P5: two or more canary entombment / stranded / livelock rows within 3 of a plinth cap. One is named, not a verdict.
